FIELD TRIAL OF RCS III MUD SYSTEM Date: 09.09.91 A new cationic water based mud, RCS III, was used in the 17 1/2 hole on Well 7/12-11. Extensive gumbo problems at surface and balled BHA's was experienced. This necessitated excessive back reaming on trips. round trips and wiper trips were made in this hole section. sers. The non-mag stabilisers seemed to have positive effect in maintaining flow path, but no firm conclusions could be drawn. The main cause appeared to be the level of inhibition provided by the RCS III mud resulting in stiffer plastic clay which was readily moulded onto exposed surfaces and was difficult to remove both mechanically and hydraulically.
